summary: The root HDD primarily means to incite, urge, or encourage someone to do something, often with a sense of hastening or pressing them. It implies a strong motivation or instigation towards an action.

headwords.def: حاضّهُ حاض حاضه حاضة , (TK,) inf. n. مُحَاضَّةٌ , (S, K,) He excited him, &c., as above, being excited, &c., by him. (S, K, TK.) headwords.def: حَضِيضٌ حضيض A depressed piece ( قَرَار ) of ground at the place where a mountain ends; (S;) or a depressed piece ( قرار ) of ground at, or by, the سَفْح [i. e. foot, or bottom, or lowest part, ] of a mountain; or in, or at, the lower, or lowest, part thereof, ( فِى أَسْفَلِهِ ,) the سفح being behind the حضيض ; the حضيض being in the part next the سفح , and the سفح being دُونَ ذٰلِكَ [which seems to be virtually a repetition, signifying behind that part, or it may mean above that part ]: (TA:) or i. q. سَفْحٌ : (K in art. سفح :) or a depressed piece ( قرار ) of ground: (A:) or a tract ( حِجزٌ [in the CK, erroneously, حَجَر ]), and a depressed piece ( قرار ), in land or ground: (K:) and any low piece ( سَافِلٌ ) of land or ground: (TA:) and the ground [in an absolute sense]: (S:) pl. [of pauc.]
